claim: No HWA 10.2.8, a sintaxe CORRETA para referenciar um run cycle group a partir de um SCHEDULE (job stream) no composer e a clausula ON com prefixo $RCG: 'ON $RCG <grupo>'. Validado no lab: um jobstream de teste com 'SCHEDULE MDM#RCGSYNTAX1 / ON $RCG LABRCG2 / : / MDM#JOB_NEEDS_A / END' passou em composer validate (AWSJCL003I, no errors, RC=0) e composer add (AWSJCL003I, errors 0, persisted 'Total objects updated: 1'). A forma 'ON RUNCYCLEGROUP LABRCG2' (sem $RCG) e rejeitada com AWSJOM915E 'Syntax error at line 2, starting from position 4 to 16' (RC=8). Isso CORRIGE a conclusao da claim hwa-lab-10.2.8-runcyclegroup-schedule-reference-uses-calendar-name-0011 (que afirmava que a associacao nao era expressavel via texto): a associacao E expressavel via '$RCG'; a claim 0011 nao havia testado a variante com prefixo $RCG. Reversao garantida: jobstream de teste removido via composer delete.
platform: Distributed; Linux x86_64; container tws-hwa (MDM); HWA 10.2.8
command: composer validate /tmp/rcg_test.def (ON $RCG LABRCG2) -> AWSJCL003I RC=0; composer add /tmp/rcg_test.def -> AWSJCL003I persisted; composer validate /tmp/rcg_fail.def (ON RUNCYCLEGROUP LABRCG2) -> AWSJOM915E RC=8; echo y | composer delete MDM#RCGSYNTAX1 -> AWSJCL003I (reversao). Mutante SO no jobstream de teste isolado; NENHUM JnextPlan/SwitchPlan/switchmgr e nenhum kill de engine.
preconditions: runcyclegroup LABRCG2 ja definido no banco (criado em 2026-09-10); job MDM#JOB_NEEDS_A existente para referencia; MDM master; postgres/containers de pe.
stop_criterion: se AWSJPL017E/lock de plano ou inconsistencia -> parar, planman unlock se preciso, reportar. Nao atingido.
reversibility: reversivel e revertido: composer delete do stream de teste (AWSJCL003I, Total objects deleted: 1); lab voltou ao estado (MDM master, plano intacto).
sanitized_output: validate ON $RCG LABRCG2: AWSJCL003I success, no errors, RC=0. add ON $RCG LABRCG2: AWSJCL003I, errors 0, Total objects updated: 1. validate ON RUNCYCLEGROUP LABRCG2: AWSJOM915E 'Syntax error at line 2, starting from position 4 to 16', RC=8. delete MDM#RCGSYNTAX1: AWSJCL003I, Total objects deleted: 1. observations: 1) O prefixo $RCG e a forma canonica de REFERENCIAR um run cycle group na clausula on de um SCHEDULE. 2) A claim 0011 (2026-09-10) testou 6 variantes sem $RCG e concluiu equivocadamente que nao era expressavel via texto; a variante $RCG (documentada na claim hwa-10.2.8-composer-runcyclegroup-0001) NAO foi testada entao e e a correta. 3) AWSJOM915E e um erro de sintaxe generico ('Syntax error at line N...'), nao especifico de runcyclegroup. 4) Mutante restrito ao jobstream de teste, revertido por delete; lab intacto.
